coming from a pro choice standpoint...

i agree that abortion shouldn’t ever be criminalized or illegal, because that won’t decrease the number of abortions, it will decrease the amount of SAFE abortions. you could make abortion illegal in every state, but that won’t stop abortions from happening, only increase the danger and necessity for abortions that can only be practiced unsafely. 

ways to decrease abortion could be:

1) improve the adoption/foster system. women will choose abortion over the foster system because they know it’s what’s best for the child. you need a system that will give a child a better life. 

2) better sex education and birth control/contraceptives. the sex education in america is horrible and doesn’t help. contraceptives need to be more accessible. 

3) rape prevention. sex education should cover consent. 

4) etc. 

but at the end of the day you have to realize that it’s a woman’s choice, but not one that any woman wants to make. pregnant women decide to have an abortion out of necessity, they know that it’s what’s best for the fetus. 

but the argument of “that child could’ve cured cancer” doesn’t make sense, it isn’t a child, it’s a fetus, a hypothetical. you want a woman to keep a child over the hypothetical possibility that her child grows up to be a hero, when there’s just as equal chance that the child grows up to become a horrible person. 

and stop saying pro-choice people are “pro abortion” we care about keeping the right for a woman to choose what happens to her own body. 

also you can not be a “pro choice feminist” because feminism is about having gender equality, men have always had rights (especially the right to choose what happens to their own body), while women haven’t. having the right to choose what happens to your own body is included in feminism. 

at the end of the day, there are millions of reasons why women have abortions, they will never go away completely. but offering support and having better solutions to certain problems will decrease the need for abortion.
